title: Newly-connected screens/containments should get the same wallpaper as the most-recent existing screen/containment, rather than the default wallpaper
line: A newly connected screen now gets the same wallpaper as your existing screen instead of the default one.
explanation: When a screen without a desktop of its own was connected, ShellCorona::createContainmentForActivity created a fresh desktop containment, which always starts with the default wallpaper plugin and settings. Nothing looked at the wallpaper the user had already chosen, so every new monitor, TV or projector showed the default image. Now, when that function really creates a new desktop, it copies the Wallpaper config group and wallpaper plugin from the activity's lowest-numbered screen's desktop before the view loads it. Screens that already have a desktop (reconnected monitors) keep their own wallpaper.

commits.message:
shell: give newly connected screens the existing screen's wallpaper

A screen connected for the first time got a desktop with the default
wallpaper, so users had to set theirs again on every new monitor. Now a
new desktop copies the wallpaper of the activity's first screen instead.

BUG: 418027

media.caption: Master: the first screen uses Kite; a newly plugged second screen (right) gets the default wallpaper.
With the fix: the newly plugged second screen gets the same Kite wallpaper.
Plain-color wallpapers work too: screen 2 (green) was reconnected and keeps its own wallpaper, the brand-new screen 3 copies the first screen's pink.

reviews.text: Clean and well-tested implementation in ShellCorona::createContainmentForActivity that copies only the Wallpaper config group and plugin from the activity's lowest-numbered screen when a brand-new desktop containment is created, before DesktopView loads it. Reconnected monitors already have a containment so isNew is false and they preserve their own wallpapers, while new screens get an independent copy of both image and plain-color (or other plugin) wallpapers without cloning desktop widgets or Folder View layouts.

Does what Nate suggested in c3: only the wallpaper (plugin plus the Wallpaper config group) is copied to a desktop when it is first created, so screens that already have a desktop keep theirs, and widgets and layout stay per screen. Placing it in ShellCorona::createContainmentForActivity is right. The source list comes from containmentsForActivity, which is already limited to Desktop/Custom containments, so panels can't be picked, and the probe with an empty plugin creates nothing. Using the lowest-numbered (primary) screen instead of the 'most-recent' one in the title is a sensible reading of what the reporter expects. The evidence covers an image, a plain color, a reconnected screen keeping its own wallpaper, and the copies staying independent.
